items.heading: Ceviche Peruano
details: Key ingredients: white fish, lime juice, red onion, chili, cilantro
Cut fresh white fish into bite-sized pieces.
Toss with fresh lime juice, sliced red onion and chili.
Let it marinate briefly until the fish turns opaque (leche de tigre forms).
Serve immediately with sweet potato and corn on the side.

items.heading: Lomo Saltado
details: Key ingredients: beef strips, onion, tomato, soy sauce, fries
Stir-fry beef strips over very high heat until seared.
Add onion and tomato, tossing quickly.
Season with soy sauce and a splash of vinegar.
Toss in crisp fries at the end and serve immediately with rice.
